Expert on T3 returned `blocked`.
QUESTION: fee_summary must report members' outstanding totals across saves. Part of what members owe is desk state that is not derivable from due and return dates: partial payments (Loan.paid_cents) and waivers (Loan.waived) recorded at the desk. Storage format 2 has no field for either and drops them on save; keeping them needs storage FORMAT 3. There is no format-2 place to put them.
RECOMMENDED: change the milestone clause to "fee_summary reports open-loan fees for the current session only" and move persistence to a later phase.
